name: European long distance path E7 - Andorra
description_md:
The European long distance path E7 - Andorra is a 43.4 km waymarked hiking route in Andorra that belongs to an international waymarked hiking network. Based on its distance and ascent, the route is classified as easy.

Signposted as E7, the route includes 1949 m of ascent and 3617 m of descent. The walking time is about 19 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. It passes Andorra la Vella within 300 m and Esglesia Sant Esteve de Andorra la Vella within 400 m.
